title: N.Y. Comp. Codes R. & Regs. Tit. 22 § 200.6 - Engagement of counsel
body:
No adjournment shall be granted on the
						ground of engagement of counsel except in accordance with Part 125 of the Rules
						of the Chief Administrator of the Courts (22 NYCRR Part 125).
